body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Bluetek presented its Bluetooth headset ''Skin'' during CES 2007. It weighs 15g and runs on internal lithium-polymer battery. It supports 12 hours of talk time and 500 hours of standby time.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Nikki Hwang, Daniel Seo >
